note: RUBRIC_SLIM_SPEC batch: old U6 L4-7 (one-proportion z test: hypotheses, conditions, p-value meaning, conclusions, errors and power; NEW Unit 3). CB significance-test scoring: (1) hypotheses with the parameter defined in context, (2) procedure named + conditions checked, (3) mechanics: test statistic and p-value, (4) conclusion: compare p to alpha, decision, in context of Ha. A p-value interpretation earns its point only with 'assuming H0 true', 'as extreme or more extreme', and context — those are one idea, not three. Applied with scripts/rubric-slim-apply.mjs. Revised after the Codex review of new U3/U4 (DO NOT SHIP -> fixed): a full inference procedure requires the ids that compose College Board's four compound points (hypotheses incl. parameter, procedure + every condition, mechanics with work, decision + justification in context) even when that is 6-8 ids; explicitly requested interpretations and reasons restored; E/P/I made uniform and disjoint (all / all-but-one / two-or-more).
